title: Fog in Amsterdam
instructions: Havalimanında rötar anonsu. Sebep, saatler ve verilen hizmete dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: This is an announcement for passengers on flight EZ 349 to Amsterdam.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Because of fog in Amsterdam, this flight is delayed by about two hours.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The new departure time is fourteen fifty.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Passengers can get a free drink and sandwich at any café in the airport. Please show your boarding pass.

script.speaker: s
script.text: We will make another announcement at one o'clock.
